doc.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Louie Bellson's funeral again
summary: Brown and Young again mention Louie Bellson's recent death and the funeral on Thursday.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Well, we just lost Louie a few weeks ago. Louie Bellson, Louie Bellson. We just lost Louie Bellson.
We just lost Louie Bellson, and I was trying to get somebody to take me to the funeral Thursday…

And I can‘t find nobody. Because I can‘t go myself, I can‘t drive. I can drive, but I don‘t know where I‘m going and everything, and I don‘t know where it is. I wish you were still here. You‘re going to be leaving, though.
Yeah, we have to leave in the morning.

You got to leave in the morning. That‘s too bad, too. Louie Bellson‘s funeral is tomorrow, I still got a chance, I might call my close friends, I called and asked them, but they… Ira Nepus is out of town with Clay Jenkins, trumpet player that plays in John Clayton‘s band. And so, he said he‘s sorry but he can‘t do it he‘s working, he‘s out of town. So I‘ll find somebody I hope. And, my daughter‘s sick, she can‘t take me, you know. She‘s got the flu, that‘s too bad too, she‘s got the flu, you know.
